_note: Organic-social profile source of truth. The public profiles present the CONSUMER brand (Guía Salud) operated by the platform (GS Allude). No legal entity, address or phone appears on a social profile until config/site.json carries a real value — and the profile link always points at the permanent consumer site with the platform's own UTM tagging, never at /for-agents (buyer application), /agent (buyer portal), /admin or a staging host.
_domain_note: Permanent https origin only (e.g. https://guiasalud.com). While empty, no link may be published: tools/social_links.py writes the links with status BLOCKED instead of guessing a host.
_landing_note: The consumer entry point: '/' is the ES-first home with the free coverage check, '/check?a=health_check' the EN check. Both are consumer pages. Any /for-agents, /para-agencias, /agent, /partner or /admin path is refused by the validator.
